quests.title: Four Months for a Boat
quests.premise: An Owing is assessed at four nushmeekos. The Owing has run eleven years. The arithmetic of the Owing contains no error.

quests.title: Names Scratched Out
quests.premise: Burnt registers and estate ledgers are the same class of document. Read together, they name people who are still held.

quests.title: The Broker's Mercy
quests.premise: A man forgave debts for thirty years. The brokerage that he built now indentures two dock crews.

quests.title: Riot Without a Banner
quests.premise: Factions inside the Rose are preparing an uprising. The factions' aims are incompatible.

quests.title: Bones to the Dirt
quests.premise: White Rose Prison holds the graves of Argonians. They died mid-Owing, far from their Hist.

quests.title: What the Rose Becomes
quests.premise: The Rose has four possible ends. Several of the ends turn on how assessment itself is done.

quests.title: A Contract in Mud
quests.premise: A settlement-defence contract understated the danger. The contract overcharged residents.

quests.title: The Missing Patrol
quests.premise: A patrol vanished after refusing an unsafe order. The tracks read as negligence.

quests.title: Wamasu Season
quests.premise: A juvenile Wamasu threatens farms. Hunters killed its prey. Hunters then took its eggs.

quests.title: The Beast in the Ledger
quests.premise: Several villages were billed for the same slain creature.

quests.title: A Fort Paid Twice
quests.premise: Two communities financed one fort restoration. The commander plans to abandon the poorer community.

quests.title: Mercy for a Monster
quests.premise: Disease transformed an Argonian. The Argonian keeps reason intermittently. The village argues cure, containment and execution.

quests.title: The Price of Protection
quests.premise: Local officers encourage bandits. The bandits keep villages dependent on charter contracts.

quests.title: Charter War
quests.premise: Reformers, mercenary captains and the Four Winds compete. They compete over the Charter's purpose.

quests.title: Signed Elsewhere, Served Here
quests.premise: An extermination order targets a marsh community. The community sits on water that the client wants. Halvar the Damp reads the order aloud before he signs it.

quests.title: No Master of Arms
quests.premise: The charter resolves as one of four outcomes. The outcomes are public service, mercenary company, auxiliary or broken cartel.

quests.title: Citizen of No Hist
quests.premise: A resident is refused civic registration. No local Hist claims the resident.

quests.title: The House Register
quests.premise: A property census regularises ownership. The census erases informal occupants and communal rights.

quests.title: Bread and Salt
quests.premise: Merchants hold supply in warehouses. Townspeople blame outsiders for shortages.

quests.title: The Murdered Delegate
quests.premise: A delegate has been killed. The killing looks ethnic. The victim was exposing League financiers.

quests.title: Trial by Water
quests.premise: A mixed city court demands a traditional ordeal.

quests.title: The Empty Ward
quests.premise: A district was evacuated for disease. Absent owners still legally occupy the district. Refugees settle in its houses.

quests.title: A Vote Bought Twice
quests.premise: Two blocs bribe the same electors. Each bloc defines corruption differently.

quests.title: The Public Canal
quests.premise: A canal improves sanitation and trade. The canal also cuts a sacred route and displaces households.

quests.title: The Open Water Charter
quests.premise: Reformers, merchants and civic officers negotiate a new charter. They negotiate against prior cases.

quests.title: Who Counts as Argonian?
quests.premise: The outcomes are a plural civic movement, a merchant oligarchy, a municipal service, or collapse.

quests.title: The Sick Root
quests.premise: A Hist is dying. The village blames upstream salt. The diagnosis has to be made underwater.

quests.title: Eggs Above the Flood
quests.premise: The nursery floods tonight. A threatened clutch goes out by boat in the dark.

quests.title: The Borrowed Tree
quests.premise: Gideon's Hist is a planted cutting. Its provenance is disputed. A Gloommire tribe claims it.

quests.title: Sap for Sale
quests.premise: A medicinal sap trade is legal. It hides coercive night harvesting, which Owing-held crews do.

quests.title: The Silent Clutch
quests.premise: Adults of one clutch share a silence. The silence was sold to them as a curable curse.

quests.title: Root Against Road
quests.premise: A causeway cuts living roots and burial ground. A span fails while the parties argue.

quests.title: The Tree That Chose Another
quests.premise: A Hist speaks more clearly to a channel-digger. The appointed Tree-Minder hears it less clearly.

quests.title: Council of Many Roots
quests.premise: The Conclave's great council cannot convene. Each delegation is stuck for a different reason.

quests.title: The Price of Guidance
quests.premise: A Tree-Minder hid a flood warning. His silence saved some people. He had moved the boundary stakes beforehand.

quests.title: No Tree Owns the Marsh
quests.premise: Ratification is under way. A chartered crew is taking a cutting under paper that the mid-game reform issued.

quests.title: Ashes in Water
quests.premise: Two families dispute the correct funeral for a relative. The relative lived outside the birth community.

quests.title: A Sermon with No Words
quests.premise: A Nisswo keeps silence and answers in gesture. His answers must be copied gesture by gesture. They can be read only after copying.

quests.title: The Name Returned
quests.premise: A dead person's name is claiming property. The spiritual dispute hides a practical fraud.

quests.title: The Sleepless Mourner
quests.premise: A mourner has dreams. The dreams read as grief, as haunting, or as a healer's manipulation.

quests.title: Teeth of Sithis
quests.premise: A splinter sect wants the province's largest Sithis temple. The sect wants the temple returned to blood.

quests.title: A Change Refused
quests.premise: A settlement leader uses tradition. The leader keeps a widow, an apprentice or an incomer out of a role.

quests.title: The False Nisswo
quests.premise: A travelling priest is admired. The priest fabricates revelations and also mediated a real peace.

quests.title: The Shape of Mercy
quests.premise: A condemned murderer asks for a ritual death. The victims demand testimony.

quests.title: Every Ending Is a Door
quests.premise: Rival schools argue about the order. One side wants the order to stay dispersed. The other side wants it to build a teaching house.

quests.title: The Turning Path
quests.premise: The outcomes are a plural network, a formal school, an itinerant tradition or a dissolved order.

quests.title: Earn Your Pole
quests.premise: The quest qualifies the pilot on a working ferry route. The route has current, passengers and a staged obstruction.

quests.title: Ferry in the Dark
quests.premise: A night ferry carries a fugitive. Law and criminals both hunt the fugitive.

quests.title: Cargo with a Pulse
quests.premise: A sealed crate holds a living creature. The creature is trafficked for alchemy.

quests.title: The Drowned Toll
quests.premise: An official toll sinks financially. Guards and pilots run a private tariff.

quests.title: Pirates of Topal
quests.premise: A pirate crew is half former ferry workers. A monopoly displaced those workers.

quests.title: Broken Pilots
quests.premise: Veteran pilots give wrong directions on purpose. They resist a map registry.

quests.title: Storm at Archon
quests.premise: A storm traps ships outside Archon. Rescue capacity is limited and must be allocated.

quests.title: A Chain Across the River
quests.premise: A merchant coalition proposes a physical chain. The coalition also proposes a monopoly checkpoint.

quests.title: Compact or Cartel
quests.premise: Violence forces an internal election. The election method decides which votes stay legitimate.

quests.title: Open Channels
quests.premise: The outcomes are a worker compact, a merchant cartel, a pirate confederation or a regulated public ferry.

quests.title: The Worm That Refused
quests.premise: A rootworm refuses a familiar route. The cause is read from evidence that shows no behaviour.

quests.title: Passenger Without a Name
quests.premise: A wanted traveller seeks transit. The traveller invokes an obsolete sanctuary custom.

quests.title: The Shortcut Sold
quests.premise: A Waykeeper sells a sacred route to smugglers. The sale funds repairs that the state refused.

quests.title: A Mouth Too Narrow
quests.premise: A route reopens only by cutting living roots or by abandoning a dependent settlement.

quests.title: The Waykeepers' Oath
quests.premise: The outcomes are open public service, a restricted sacred order, a state transport bureau or dispersed keepers.

quests.title: A Book That Breathes Water
quests.premise: The task is to recover a waterproofed text. The text lies in an inhabited submerged ruin. The ruin's owners are present.

quests.title: Borrowed Memory
quests.premise: A scholar uses volunteered Hist-memory fragments. The scholar then cannot prove that consent survived translation.

quests.title: The Weight of a Name
quests.premise: An untranslated tablet exists. It makes a modern family the heirs of a long-dormant office.

quests.title: The College at the Door
quests.premise: College envoys offer independence from Imperial bureaucracy. The envoys hide a binding experiment.

quests.title: Synod in the Cellar
quests.premise: The Synod offers funding and instruments. The Synod demands exclusive custody of every discovery.

quests.title: A Dead Scholar's Method
quests.premise: A researcher was murdered. The researcher's notes rebuild from field sites. The killer was shielding a community.

quests.title: A Ruin with Two Owners
quests.premise: An excavated Xanmeer is a sacred site. It is also a settlement's quarry.

quests.title: The Experiment That Escaped
quests.premise: A construct is loose in the waterways. Its wake is read at fixed breach points.

quests.title: Three Charters
quests.premise: Synod, College and independent scholars each offer an institutional future. The futures are incompatible.

quests.title: What We Publish
quests.premise: A discovery can delegitimise land claims or expose sacred information. Publication is the choice.

quests.title: Last of the Scale
quests.premise: A dying contract-killer claims to be the last trained Shadowscale. The killer then asks for the list of surviving initiates.

quests.title: Writ Without a King
quests.premise: The first test is a writ. The writ's issuing authority no longer exists.

quests.title: The Empty Cradle
quests.premise: A ruined hatchery's records show children redirected into state service. One survivor denies consenting.

quests.title: Born Under Shadow
quests.premise: Three revivalist claimants want Iiran-Vekh for his birth sign. Iiran-Vekh intends to go on building boats.

quests.title: A Brother from Falkreath
quests.premise: A Dark Brotherhood emissary offers legitimacy. The price is absorption.

quests.title: The Honest Target
quests.premise: A contract names a corrupt magistrate. The patron is erasing a conviction.

quests.title: Two Knives, One Name
quests.premise: Two assassins share one Shadowscale title. Proving which is genuine does not prove which is guilty.

quests.title: The State's Hand
quests.premise: The Veiled Reed offers a charter. The charter gives protection and resources for state-directed contracts.

quests.title: No Listener in Black Marsh
quests.premise: A rite is meant to reach the Night Mother. It yields ambiguous evidence over a staged deception.

quests.title: Shadow at Dawn
quests.premise: The surviving claimants force a final choice. The choice decides what the order becomes.

quests.title: The Memorial with Two Dates
quests.premise: Two communities commemorate different atrocities. They commemorate at one site.

quests.title: A Body on the Ferry
quests.premise: A killing looks political. The victim was moving Owing-held labourers as freight.

quests.title: Whoever Was Standing In Them
quests.premise: The saltrice fields carry no titles, only occupation. The holder works them under Owings.

quests.title: The Retaliation List
quests.premise: Both militias keep lists of civilians to seize if fighting starts.

quests.title: Ash-Reed Accord
quests.premise: The outcomes are a truth commission, a security pact, a closed separation or a factional victory.

quests.title: A Dry Hand in a Wet City
quests.premise: The task is to recover stolen property. The thief took it from another thief. The thief must not be harmed.

quests.title: The Drowned Lockbox
quests.premise: Three clients claim a lockbox in a sunken counting house. The contents expose all three clients.

quests.title: Honest Customs
quests.premise: Customs officers run an illegal tariff. A smuggler uses the scandal to move captives.

quests.title: The House That Floats
quests.premise: A wealthy household's hull tally passes from hand to hand on the moored flotilla.

quests.title: A Fence in Every Port
quests.premise: Three candidate fences compete. Reliability matters more than any quota.

quests.title: The Rootworm Robbery
quests.premise: A sealed state packet is intercepted. The interception happens along a rootworm transit.

quests.title: The Informer's Cut
quests.premise: A traitor is selling guild routes. Every piece of evidence points at a climber. The climber is innocent.

quests.title: The Vault Beneath Pusbottom
quests.premise: A flooded municipal vault teaches route planning. The vault comes before the grand heist.

quests.title: Tools of the Grand Heist
quests.premise: Two preparations of four are chosen. Each preparation opens an optional route.

quests.title: The Palace Below the Tide
quests.premise: The Crown Ledger heist crosses reception rooms, roofs, service canals and a guarded archive.

quests.title: Who Owns the Night?
quests.premise: The ledger proves that patrons, merchants and officials jointly engineered housing seizures.

quests.title: A Voice Recorded Twice
quests.premise: Two witness texts contradict each other. One text was edited after its author died.

quests.title: The Sleeping Hist Fragment
quests.premise: A recovered sap sample is treated as evidence, as relic and as hazard at once.

quests.title: Pusbottom's Missing House
quests.premise: A vanished household was left off every official casualty list.

quests.title: The Refuge
quests.premise: The province's Umbriel memorial is a cursed plateau. Locals avoid it.

quests.title: The Public Record
quests.premise: The outcomes are a full archive, protected testimony, an official narrative or sealed evidence.
